Name: Telvana
Other names: the Telvanian isle, the lost nation
Summary
The island nation of the Telvani, an ancient people devoted to Valona.
Details
Realm: Mortal world
Type: Island nation
Status: city destroyed; island sealed by the Elves
Description
Telvana rises out of the Cloud Sea as pale limestone cliffs.
At its height the city was a place of beautiful marble buildings.
History
After the War of Light, Valona gave the Staff of Light to the Telvani sage Celos.
Notes per book
Shards of Light (Book 1).

* Tom sees Telvana’s cliffs on his flight home to Elandroth.
* In Ursvald, Ciles suggests that the elder Elves might live there.

Relationships
Home of: Telvani
Contains: Telvana Citadel
Sealed by: Elves
Owned by: Thomas Terrance Smith
Associated with: Celos, Staff of Light
Spoilers
In Book 1 the Fall is only a “mysterious attack”.
